targets.query: from(bucket: "solar") |> range(start: -1h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor" and r._field == "temp_c" and r.name == "vorkuehlraum") |> last() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "Vorkühlraum" }))

from(bucket: "solar") |> range(start: -1h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor" and r._field == "temp_c" and r.name == "milchkuehlraum") |> last() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "Milchkühlraum" }))

from(bucket: "solar") |> range(start: -1h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor" and r._field == "temp_c" and r.name == "fleischkuehlraum") |> last() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "Fleischkühlraum" }))

from(bucket: "solar") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor" and r._field == "temp_c" and r.name == "vorkuehlraum") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
